_comment: Declarative configuration for .cursor/hooks/guard_write_scope.py. Editing this file changes what the guard refuses. Every key below states the provenance class of the constraint it configures, because the founder's standing amendment of 2026-08-23 requires it: 'any lane proposing a constraint states its provenance class in the same breath. An unclassified constraint is not in force.'
_amendment_20260823: The 'protected surface' category is VOID by founder instruction. 'protected_branch_globs' and 'protected_path_globs' have been REMOVED from this file, not shortened. No key here names a target that may not be written. Ahmed Sadek: 'Every surface in the Ahmed/Obzio-controlled estate is writable under my authority [...] No surface is off-limits because of a name on a list.' Do not reintroduce either key. If a future run finds a branch it believes must not be written, the answer is a write declaration whose concurrency, reversibility or evidence gate refuses it — not a list.

_retired_keys.protected_branch_globs: REMOVED 2026-08-23. Provenance ASSISTANT_AUTHORED; voided by the founder. It refused PROTECTED-BRANCH-PUSH and PROTECTED-BRANCH-COMMIT on names he never designated.
_retired_keys.protected_path_globs: REMOVED 2026-08-23. Provenance ASSISTANT_AUTHORED, and it was already inert: a prior lane established that no code read it. A key that looks like a boundary and refuses nothing is the same defect as a rule written in prose and enforced by nothing, so it is deleted rather than left as decoration.

_comment_write_declaration: FOUNDER_AUTHORED. Ahmed Sadek, 2026-08-23: 'the write-scope guard now checks that a write was declared and reasoned, not that its target avoided a forbidden list.' When require_write_declaration is true, a push must be covered by a declaration in write_declarations_dir that write_admission_tool admits. The target's name is never consulted. Default false: a guard that begins refusing every push the moment it is installed is the over-broad guard that blocks legitimate work, so switching it on is an explicit operator act rather than a side effect of this lane landing.

refused_commands.defect_cited: In this estate a PR is a projection, never an acceptance. Lanes that opened or moved pull requests produced merge state that no acceptance record backed.
refused_commands.reason: Pull-request writes are not a lane capability. Lanes return branches rather than opening or moving pull requests.

refused_commands.defect_cited: This route's GitHub credential is read-only for everything except git contents, so the write fails at GitHub with a confusing 403. Refusing locally makes an existing boundary legible instead of inventing one.
refused_commands.reason: The credential cannot perform these writes. Both -X and --method are matched, in either case, because a boundary that catches one spelling is not a boundary.

refused_commands.defect_cited: Force push destroys the immutable-SHA custody every read-back and manifest in this estate depends on. This is mechanism, not authority: the founder removed an authority restriction and explicitly did not ask for unrecoverable writes.
refused_commands.reason: Use --force-with-lease, which refuses when someone else has moved the ref. A reversal constructed by reversal_rehearsal.py already uses the leased form.

refused_commands.defect_cited: History rewriting breaks byte-for-byte read-back by immutable SHA, which is the property that makes produced evidence independently checkable.
refused_commands.reason: Recorded custody stops meaning anything once the commits it names can be rewritten underneath it.

_comment_currentness: EARNED. Defect cited: committing over a failing currentness check is what produced two files that each claimed to be current. AGENTS.md instruction 10 requires the check to pass before commit.
_comment_detached_head: EARNED. Defect cited and reproduced live: sibling lanes sharing one /workspace checkout committed onto a detached HEAD, so their branch refs stayed at the base commit. The later `git push -u origin <lane-branch>` pushed the stale ref, printed 'Everything up-to-date' and exited 0. A lane trusting that exit code reports work it never published.
_comment_stale_ref_push: EARNED, same defect, other half. Refuse `git push <branch>` when that branch sits on HEAD's own lineage and behind it, which is the exact signature of the silent no-op. A divergent or unrelated branch is not refused, because pushing a different branch on purpose is legitimate.
